_comment: Known-failing MUST requirements for the official a2aproject/a2a-tck suite. Regenerate with tck/scripts/check_conformance.py --update. Every entry here is an open defect tracked in docs/official-tck-findings.md — shrinking this file is the point. Four entries (CORE-CANCEL-002, GRPC-ERR-002, HTTP_JSON-STATUS-001, STREAM-SUB-003) are one cause: the suite vendors A2A v1.0.0 (per its own specification/version.json) and grades §5.4 against it, while A2A v1.0.1 rewrote six of that table's nine rows. Reported upstream as a2aproject/a2a-tck#231; they clear when it refreshes the snapshot. See §20, §21 and §21.1. CORE-SEND-003 is a different defect in the suite: the requirement declares no expected_error, so the harness demands that a send carrying an unsupported media type succeed, contradicting its own title and §3.1.1. See §22. HTTP_JSON-ERR-001 and HTTP_JSON-SVC-001 are the same stale copy on another line: its §11.1 says application/json for HTTP+JSON, which v1.0.1 changed to "application/a2a+json SHOULD be used"; this SDK answers the v1.0.1 media type since 2026-10-15. See §23.
